description_en: Adds a policy to an access configuration
description_zh: 为访问配置添加权限策略
kebab_example: aliyun cloudsso add-permission-policy-to-access-configuration --directory-id d-00fc2p610000 --access-configuration-id ac-00jhtfl8thteu6uj0000 --permission-policy-type System --permission-policy-name AliyunECSFullAccess --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddPermissionPolicyToAccessConfiguration

parameters.help_en: The ID of the access configuration
parameters.name: access_configuration_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the policy. Valid values:

System: system policy. Resource Access Management (RAM) system policies are reused.

Inline: inline policy. Inline policies are created based on the RAM policy syntax and structure
parameters.help_zh:
权限策略类型。取值：

System：系统策略。复用RAM的系统策略。
Inline：内置策略。按照RAM权限策略语法和结构编写的自定义策略
parameters.name: permission_policy_type

parameters.help_en:
The name of the policy.

If you set `PermissionPolicyType` to `System`, you must set PermissionPolicyName to the name of a system policy. You can obtain the name of the system policy from RAM.

If you set `PermissionPolicyType` to `Inline`, you must set PermissionPolicyName to the name of an inline policy. A custom value is supported. The value can be up to 32 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
权限策略名称。具体如下：

当`PermissionPolicyType`为`System`时，该参数为系统策略名称。由于复用的是RAM系统策略，请在RAM中获取系统策略名称。
当`PermissionPolicyType`为`Inline`时，该参数为内置策略名称。您可以自定义该参数。长度最大为32个字符
parameters.name: permission_policy_name

parameters.help_en:
The configurations of the inline policy.

The value can be up to 4,096 characters in length.

If you set `PermissionPolicyType` to `Inline`, you must specify this parameter. For more information about the syntax and structure of RAM policies, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93739.html
parameters.help_zh:
内置策略内容。

长度：最大4096个字符。

当`PermissionPolicyType`为`Inline`时，该参数必须配置。关于权限策略的语法和结构，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93739.html
parameters.name: inline_policy_document
